naruto: The loud, stubborn knucklehead who wants to become Hokage and win over a village that once shunned him. As the hero of the series and host of the Nine-Tailed Fox, Naruto has more cards than any other character, and he appears in every main set of the game.
sasuke: The last of the Uchiha clan, Sasuke is Naruto's rival and best friend, driven by a quest for power and revenge. His Sharingan and Chidori make him a fan favorite, and his cards run from the very first set to the last.
kakashi: Team 7's laid-back sensei, the Copy Ninja famous for his Sharingan eye, his mask and his ever-present book. Kakashi is one of the most popular characters in the series and appears from the first set to the last.
itachi: Sasuke's older brother and a member of the Akatsuki, Itachi is one of the most feared and mysterious ninja in the series. His Sharingan and Akatsuki cloak make him a favorite with collectors.
gaara: The Sand Village's Jinchuriki of the One-Tailed beast, Gaara starts as a terrifying opponent and grows into the Kazekage. His journey from villain to hero made him one of the series' most loved characters.
sakura: The third member of Team 7, Sakura grows from a lovesick academy student into a powerful medical ninja trained by Tsunade. Her cards follow that whole arc, from the early Team 7 sets to her monster-strength fighting style.
hinata: The shy heiress of the Hyuga clan, Hinata quietly cheers Naruto on and fights with the Byakugan and Gentle Fist. She's one of the most loved characters in the series, and her cards are popular with collectors.
jiraiya: One of the Legendary Sannin, Jiraiya is a toad-summoning master, Naruto's mentor and the author of the Make-Out series. His cards mix big jutsu art with the comic side that made him a fan favorite.
minato: The Fourth Hokage, known as the Yellow Flash of the Leaf, and Naruto's father. Minato appears in the game as both Minato Namikaze and The Fourth Hokage, and Jonin counts both names toward him.
madara: A founder of the Leaf Village and a legend of the Uchiha clan, Madara is one of the series' great villains. He has only a handful of cards, all from the later sets.
obito: Kakashi's former teammate, long thought dead, whose story is one of the biggest twists in the series. His cards include his masked identity, Tobi, and Jonin counts both names toward Obito.
pain: The leader of the Akatsuki, Pain controls six bodies through the Rinnegan, with Nagato pulling the strings behind them. His assault on the Leaf Village is one of the most famous arcs in the series, and his cards come from the later sets.
shikamaru: The lazy genius of the Nara clan, who finds everything a drag but out-thinks nearly every opponent with his Shadow Possession Jutsu. He's a fan favorite from the original Leaf genin and appears across many sets.
rock-lee: Might Guy's devoted student, Rock Lee can't use ninjutsu or genjutsu, so he trains his body to the limit with pure taijutsu. His fight with Gaara is one of the most famous in the series, and his cards are crowd favorites.
neji: A prodigy of the Hyuga branch family with a mastery of the Byakugan and Gentle Fist. Neji's arc from bitter fatalist to loyal friend made him one of the most popular members of Team Guy.
orochimaru: One of the Legendary Sannin, Orochimaru turned his back on the Leaf in his search for forbidden jutsu and immortality. He's the main villain of the early series and one of its most memorable.
tsunade: One of the Legendary Sannin and the Fifth Hokage, Tsunade is the greatest medical ninja of her time, with legendary strength and terrible luck at gambling. Her cards come from the Search for Tsunade arc onward.
deidara: An explosive-clay artist and member of the Akatsuki who believes true art is a single bang. Deidara's battles with Gaara and Sasuke made him a favorite among the Akatsuki.
might-guy: Rock Lee's sensei and Kakashi's self-proclaimed eternal rival, Might Guy is a taijutsu master overflowing with the power of youth.
killer-bee: The rapping Jinchuriki of the Eight-Tails from the Cloud Village, who helps Naruto master his own tailed beast. Killer Bee arrives in the later sets, so his cards are among the newer ones in the game.
ino: A member of Team 10 and Sakura's rival, Ino uses her clan's mind-transfer jutsu. Fans of Ino-Shika-Cho often collect her alongside Shikamaru and Choji.
choji: The kind-hearted Team 10 member whose Akimichi clan jutsu let him grow to giant size. Choji's loyalty to Shikamaru and his food pills are classic moments from the early series.
temari: Gaara's older sister, a wind-style fighter from the Sand Village who wields a giant fan. Temari appears from the Chunin Exams onward, often alongside her brothers Gaara and Kankuro.
kiba: A member of Team 8 who fights side by side with his ninja dog, Akamaru. Kiba rounds out Team 8 with Hinata and Shino.
tenten: Team Guy's weapons specialist, who can summon a storm of kunai, shuriken and scrolls. She completes Team Guy alongside Rock Lee and Neji.
shino: The quiet Team 8 member from the Aburame clan, who fights with swarms of insects living inside his body. Shino's cards round out Team 8 alongside Hinata and Kiba.
kabuto: Orochimaru's right hand, a skilled medical ninja and spy. Kabuto is behind many of the early series' biggest twists.
kisame: Itachi's Akatsuki partner, a shark-like swordsman of the Mist who wields the chakra-eating blade Samehada. He's a must for Akatsuki collectors.
kankuro: Gaara's older brother and a puppet master from the Sand Village who fights with puppets like Crow and Black Ant. Kankuro appears from the Chunin Exams onward, often with his siblings.
haku: Zabuza's loyal companion, with a rare ice style and a mirror technique that nearly defeats Team 7 in their first real mission. Haku's story is one of the most memorable of the Land of Waves arc, and he appears from the very first set.
zabuza: The Demon of the Hidden Mist, a rogue ninja swordsman with a huge cleaver who is Team 7's first great enemy. Zabuza appears from the very first set.
asuma: The Team 10 sensei and son of the Third Hokage, who fights with chakra blades. Asuma's bond with Shikamaru is at the heart of one of the series' most emotional arcs.
sai: A ROOT ninja who joins Team 7 as Sasuke's replacement and fights with ink drawings that come to life. Sai arrives midway through the game's run.
third-hokage: Hiruzen Sarutobi, the Third Hokage, known as the Professor for his mastery of every jutsu in the Leaf. His last stand against Orochimaru during the Chunin Exams is one of the series' most famous fights.
sasori: Sasori of the Red Sand, an Akatsuki puppet master who turned himself into a puppet. His fight with Sakura and Granny Chiyo is a highlight of the Kazekage Rescue arc, and his cards come from the later sets.
hidan: A foul-mouthed Akatsuki member who can't be killed and whose curse jutsu turns his own wounds on his enemies. Hidan and his partner Kakuzu appear in the later sets.
kakuzu: Hidan's Akatsuki partner, a bounty hunter obsessed with money who keeps extra hearts stolen from his victims. His cards come from the later sets alongside Hidan's.
konohamaru: The Third Hokage's grandson, who looks up to Naruto as his big brother and rival and wants to become Hokage himself.
iruka: Naruto's Academy teacher and the first person to really believe in him. Iruka is a favorite for fans of the early series.
yamato: A former ANBU and the only ninja who can use Wood Style after the First Hokage. Yamato steps in to lead Team 7 later in the series and arrives midway through the game's run.
